claimText: If the aircraft fails to indicate that it is able to receive and acknowledge transmissions, separation shall be maintained based on the assumption that the aircraft will commence descent from the navigation aid or fix specified in 4) at, or as close as possible to, the expected approach time last received and acknowledged; or, if no expected approach time has been received and acknowledged, at, or as close as possible to, the estimated time of arrival resulting from the current flight plan.
